map.→ 打开房产（面积/产权/产籍）测量工具: -> Open the property (area / title / register) measurement tool
map.与面积-24 同算法不同场景。: The same algorithm as area-24 but for a different scenario.
map.和 area-24 区别？: How does it differ from area-24?
map.坡度角能直接当坡比吗？: Can the slope angle be used directly as the slope ratio?
map.坡比常写 1:n（n=cotθ），25% 坡≈1:4，工程更用坡比表达。: The slope ratio is usually written 1:n (n = cot theta), so a 25% slope is about 1:4; engineering uses the slope ratio more often.
map.房产面积 = 套内面积 + 分摊共有面积: Property area = internal area + allocated shared area
map.房产面积测量工具：按户型尺寸或分户界址计算房产建筑面积，辅助产权与产籍测绘核算。: Property area measurement tool: computes the gross floor area from layout dimensions or per-unit boundaries, supporting title and register surveying.
map.由坐标增量(Δx,Δy)求方位角: Derive the azimuth from the coordinate increments (dx, dy)
map.算法相同，仅面向场景（梯田/边坡）不同，结果口径一致。: The algorithm is the same; only the target scenario (terrace / slope) differs, and the result definitions are consistent.
map.长宽输入算面积与坡度。: Enter the length and width to compute the area and the slope.
map.：每级宽 80m、高差 20m → 25% 坡，梯壁按此核算砌护量。: : Each bench is 80m wide with a 20m height difference → a 25% slope; the retaining wall volume is calculated from this.
